headline: Tomb Raider Legacy of Atlantis Feb 12
title: Tomb Raider Legacy of Atlantis Release Date February 12 | Delayed | Gaming News
video_script: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis has been delayed into twenty twenty seven. Its new release date is February twelfth, twenty twenty seven. The Unreal Engine five remake of the original Tomb Raider is made by Crystal Dynamics and comes to PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Lara returns to Atlantis. Are you excited? Comment below!
description: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is now dated February 12, 2027 on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S after a delay from 2026. Sources: Push Square, Stevivor, Video Games Chronicle.
